hero.description: We are a group of companies specialized in port operations and integrated logistics with presence in Manzanillo and Ensenada.

about.label: About us
about.title: The logistics group of the Mexican Pacific
about.body: Western Group is a holding company with over 20 years of experience in logistics and port operations. We integrate specialized services under one identity: reliable, agile, and committed to safety and the environment.

units.label: Our units
units.title: Integrated services for the logistics chain

container.name: Container Services
container.desc: Storage, handling and specialized services for maritime cargo containers in Manzanillo and Ensenada.

stevedoring.name: Stevedoring
stevedoring.desc: Loading and unloading services with high-tonnage equipment and certified personnel at the main Pacific ports.

logistics.name: Logistics Services
logistics.desc: Comprehensive cargo management, customs agency, land transport and tailored solutions for importers and exporters.

tankcare.name: Tank Care
tankcare.desc: Specialized technical cleaning, maintenance and repair of ISO tanks (FG & Chemicals) in Manzanillo, 5.5 km from the port.

coverage.label: Coverage
coverage.title: Presence across the Mexican Pacific
coverage.desc: We operate from the two most important ports on the Pacific, with immediate connectivity to terminals, yards and land routes.

manzanillo.title: Manzanillo, Colima
manzanillo.desc: Mexico's most active Pacific port. Home to Tank Care, Container Services and Stevedoring. 5.5 km from the inland port terminal.

ensenada.title: Ensenada, Baja California
ensenada.desc: Strategic port on the northwest border. Home to Container Services, Stevedoring and Logistics with direct access to U.S. trade corridors.

contact.label: Contact
contact.title: Let's talk
contact.desc: We are ready to be your strategic partner in Manzanillo and Ensenada. Write or call us through your preferred channel.

footer.tagline: We are the wind in your favor.
